canonical_project: Data Vault Pakistan AI Data Centre (Karachi)
owner: Data Vault Pakistan / Telenor Pakistan partnership
notes: Pakistan's first AI-focused data centre, launched in Karachi (SIFC-facilitated; market reports date launch to June 2025). Telenor Pakistan partnered (Nov 2025) to deliver Pakistan's first locally hosted sovereign AI cloud on the facility; Data Vault also partners with Rafay on a hyperscale-style sovereign AI platform on NVIDIA-accelerated computing. Marketing claims of 'first/largest/100% solar' recorded as operator wording; capacity not disclosed.
